import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.agreement import best_band_from_counts as B
from collections import Counter
import main as M

def band(vals, eps, weights=None):
    c = {}
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        c[v] = c.get(v, 0) + (1 if weights is None else weights[i])
    return B(c, 1000000 - eps)

print(band([100, 105, 200], 50000), 'expect (102, 2)')
print(band([10, 11, 12], 100000), 'expect (10, 2)')
